\section{Sensory Panel}
The panel consisted of 9 trained assessors.
Panellists were selected according to their performance in
triangular tests and completed forty hours of training on the
descriptive vocabulary before the first session.
Each attribute was rated on a 15-centimetre unstructured line scale,
anchored at both ends.

\section{Chemical Methods}
Volatile compounds were extracted by solid-phase microextraction
and analysed by gas chromatography coupled to mass spectrometry.
Peak identification rested on retention indices and library
spectra, and quantification used the internal-standard method
with 2-methyl-3-heptanone.
